title: Gestelt — NUSwarm and Flywoo bench measurements in the physical-platform parameter collection
creator: Temasek-Dynamics; John Tan et al. (companion publication)
rights: Public repository, no root license found in fixed tree. Only original aggregates are distributed.
evidence: Four bench CSV files. Names mark edited, consolidated and trimmed variants. Count row identity across variants before interpreting them as separate experiments. Force is in kgf. Optical speed can use -1 as a recorded value. Calibration and timestamps absent from the files.

companion.title: Gestelt: A Framework for Accelerating the Sim-To-Real Transition for Swarm UAVs
companion.authors: John Tan, Tianchen Sun, Feng Lin, Rodney Teo and Boo Cheong Khoo
companion.level: Publisher abstract and repository README. Source of the framework identity. No claim that article reports the cleaned file comparison.

fixed_file_url_rule: Append each file path, percent-encoded one segment at a time, to https://github.com/Temasek-Dynamics/gestelt/blob/71b462eccd6f457976fca1c736ee96b5f335d373/
scope: Bench-level inspection of command and independent physical measurements for R2. No flight deployment or controller optimization.
joined_input_boundary: These sources do not establish an upstream unclamped torque demand, its post-limiter command and an independently calibrated shaft torque on a common time base.
